item.text: The queue was comparing priority names alphabetically, so `"normal"` sorted ahead of `"urgent"`. Beacon’s account override hid that defect for its shipments. I’m making the batch sort use the same service ranks and keeping Beacon’s preference within each priority tier.

Fixed dispatch ordering to use the defined service ranks in both the queue and batch sort. Urgent shipments now precede normal shipments across accounts; Beacon’s preference still applies within each priority tier.
